notes: Initial SC TO-I for a quarterly DRIP-funded share repurchase offer. Size is an estimate of 390,941 shares (stated as 90 percent of DRIP proceeds from the April 1 2021 dividend) and depends on the purchase price. Price is NAV per share as of May 31 2021, set by the pricing committee; the NAV figure is not in the excerpt, so final_price_per_share is null. The filing's $7.28 and $2,846,049.40 figures are illustrative (NAV at Dec 31 2020), not the purchase price. A later notice in the excerpt says NAV is determined within 48 hours before repurchase; nav_pricing_date keeps the May 31 2021 wording. fund_type bdc is the filer's stated election under the 1940 Act. Commencement date is not stated as a separate date (the offer is dated April 12 2021), so null. Odd-lot priority applies to holders of fewer than 100 shares and is not coded separately.
